result.topic_en: The right column holds a draft of a letter to Riemann's father reporting that he has passed his colloquium, plus a struck-through fragment on living force; the upside-down left column holds notes on Herbart's metaphysics (metaphysics as the investigation of concepts) and a list of Herbart's early writings.
